conservative.read: This conservative approach targets a modest ~1.5% monthly return, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions.

balanced.read: This balanced approach aims for ~2.5% monthly growth by blending broad index and quality tech. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets ~4% monthly returns by significantly increasing leveraged ETF exposure. This approach carries substantially higher drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay. Strict stop discipline is paramount to manage potential rapid losses.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly distributions by rotating into income ETFs and broad index. It aims for low drawdown and reliable income, but distributions are variable and NAV can still decline in market downturns.
